evals.prompt: I need to write this week's newsletter. Topic: founders are wasting hours every week manually updating their CRM after sales calls — typing in notes, updating deal stages, logging next steps. I want a workflow that does all of this automatically right after a call ends.
evals.expected_output: Full workflow newsletter with TLDR, 4-8 steps, full prompts written out, limitations section, soft CTA. Should research tools that can capture call data and push to CRM. Should not assume any specific architecture pattern upfront.

evals.prompt: Help me write a workflow article. Pain point: founders have no idea when a competitor changes their pricing page or launches a new feature — they find out weeks later from a customer. Build a workflow that monitors competitor pages and sends a Slack alert with an AI summary whenever something changes.
evals.expected_output: Full workflow newsletter. Should research the topic landscape first, then tools for web monitoring and change detection, present options to user, then write article in house style.

evals.prompt: Write a workflow article for founders on how to turn raw customer support tickets into a weekly insight report — right now support data just sits in Intercom or Freshdesk and nobody reads it. I want AI to surface the top recurring complaints every week automatically.
evals.expected_output: Should first clarify the pain/trigger/output, then research tools, then produce newsletter. Should be medium complexity — not just summarise tickets with a prompt, but a repeatable automated system.
